indexObservation.sourceTitle: How much do hostels cost around the world? Hostel Price Index for 2023 - Price of Travel
indexObservation.propertyName: The 3 Ducks Eiffel Tower by Hiphohostels
indexObservation.evidenceText: The Price of Travel Hostel Index table lists Paris, France, The 3 Ducks Eiffel Tower by Hiphohostels, at $39.36 per night. Its methodology states that the price is for one person in a shared dorm room, including taxes and fees, using the average of a Thursday and Friday night in mid-April 2023.
indexObservation.referencePeriod: Average Thursday and Friday night in mid-April 2023; article dated 2023-01-16.
